turns.text: Should I rent, buy, or API an H100 for Llama-3-70B at 50 rps for 3 years?

**TL;DR: Neocloud rental is cheapest at $2.43/M output tokens — 1.8× cheaper than on-demand hyperscaler, 7% cheaper than the Together AI API.** Owning (3-year depreciation) runs at $3.12/M — 29% more than neocloud, so you'd only own if you had very steady > 70% utilisation plus a reason to keep the capex on-balance.

Workload sized at ~50 rps = ~2.5 B output tokens/year. All five options sit between $2.40 and $4.40 per million output tokens — not an order of magnitude apart, so the choice turns on operational preference (lock-in, latency SLO, who owns the ops burden) rather than raw $.
